# data-types (Veri tipleri)


## En çok kullanılan temel tipler

{{< include ../course-content/tables/table-datatypes-basic.md >}}


## Primitive/value/reference tipleri

| Concept         | C#                         | Java                                      | TypeScript                       |
| --------------- | -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Value types     | `struct`, primitives       | primitives                                | ❌ (all objects)                  |
| Reference types | `class`, `array`, `string` | `class`, `array`, `String`                | objects, arrays, functions       |
| Pass-by         | Value or reference         | Always value (references passed by value) | Always value (object references) |
